Pick FreeQrly if you want editable codes and statistics without a trial clock or a per-code allowance, plus batch runs, barcodes, and an API at no extra tier.

Pick QR Code Generator if you run campaigns inside Bitly's ecosystem, need team seats and white-labeling at the top tier, or want its 22 code types and hosted pages. Its paid tiers are the more corporate setup; FreeQrly is the simpler free-first one.
Are static codes really free on both?
Yes. QR Code Generator's own FAQ says all of its static codes are free and yours forever, and FreeQrly static codes are free with no sign-up. Neither expires.
What does the 14-day trial mean?

After signing up, QR Code Generator lets you try all features free for 14 days. Editing and tracking live in the PRO version, so when the trial ends you need a paid plan to keep them. FreeQrly's free dynamic codes have no trial clock.
Do I need an account to download PNG or SVG?
On QR Code Generator, yes: high-resolution JPG is the free download, and PNG, SVG, or EPS downloads require account signup. On FreeQrly, static PNG and SVG downloads need no sign-up.

Close: QR Code Generator PRO starts at $9.99 per month billed annually for 2 dynamic codes, while FreeQrly Pro is $9 per month or $90 per year for unlimited dynamic codes. At the entry tier you pay about the same and get far more editable codes at FreeQrly; QR Code Generator's higher tiers add team seats, bulk creation, and API allowances that FreeQrly's single Pro tier does not itemize.
